name: Departmental Expense Drill Down
prompt:
"Create a 'Departmental Expense Drill-Down' app. The data structure is hierarchical: Department (e.g., Engineering) -> Team (e.g., Frontend, QA) -> Expense Item (e.g., Software Licenses, Hardware).

The UI must include:

A master table showing just the Departments and their total aggregated spending.

Clicking on a row in the master table must expand it or open a side panel showing a breakdown of the individual Teams within that department.

A donut chart that dynamically updates to show the expense item breakdown only for the currently selected Department or Team."

thought_process.interpretation: The user requires a hierarchical data explorer focused on financial transparency. I've interpreted the persona as a Finance Manager or Business Analyst who needs to identify spending hotspots. The app follows a 'Master-Detail' pattern where selecting a high-level entity (Department) filters and reveals granular data (Teams and Items).
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A 'side_panel.md' skill would be beneficial for standardizing drawer-based drill-downs. Additionally, a 'hierarchy_bread_crumbs.md' component would help users navigate deep data structures.
